The target shareholders receive a combination of $155 in cash plus 0.7720 shares of Parent Common Stock per Company share outstanding (the Merger Consideration), with cash in lieu of fractional shares; no CVRs are included.
Per Share Cash Amount: $155; Exchange Ratio: 0.7720 shares of Parent Common Stock per Company Stock; plus cash in lieu of fractional shares payable under Section 2.1(d); and dividends or other distributions payable on the Parent Common Stock under Section 2.2(d) as applicable.
Each outstanding Company Stock share will be canceled and converted into $155 in cash and 0.7720 shares of Parent Common Stock (the fixed exchange ratio of 0.7720 per Company share), with any fractional-share cash payable or handled as described in Section 2.1(d).
